question: Find the surface area of a cube, whose each side measures 9 cm
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a **cube** = 6 × (side)²

⇒ TSA = 6 × 9²

⇒ TSA = 6 × 81 = 486

**∴ The correct answer is 486 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Side** of the **cube** (a) = 9 cm

**Formula Used:**

**Surface Area** of **Cube** = 6a²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66a9a5d242d9dead0d95fcbf7568d36860152dc5f75a15b6bd184d3c89188283.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Surface Area** = 6 × (9)²

⇒ **Surface Area** = 6 × 81

⇒ **Surface Area** = 486 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 486 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cube

The **volume** represents the **capacity** or space occupied, calculated as V = a³.

Lateral Surface Area of a Cube

The **area** of the **four vertical faces** (excluding top and bottom) is given by 4a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The length of the **longest rod** that can be placed inside the **cube** is d = a√3.</p
